    d1.[order_date] AS [orders_order_date],
    d1.[ship_to_id] AS [orders_ship_to_id],
    d2.[product_id] AS [products_product_id],

    d2.[category_id] AS [products_category_id],
    d3.[customer_id] AS [customers_customer_id],
    d3.[name] AS [customers_name],
    d3.[country] AS [customers_country],
    d4.[id] AS [categories_id],
    d4.[name] AS [categories_name]
FROM [shop].[order_items] AS f
    LEFT JOIN [shop].[orders] AS d1 ON f.[order_id] = d1.[order_id]
    LEFT JOIN [shop].[products] AS d2 ON f.[product_id] = d2.[product_id]
    LEFT JOIN [shop].[customers] AS d3 ON d1.[customer_id] = d3.[customer_id]
    LEFT JOIN [shop].[categories] AS d4 ON d2.[category_id] = d4.[id]
